Maintainer ruling · 2026-11-21T04:14Z · On the seat's decision card 「行内编辑日期的快捷项「下周」是 7 天后,还是下周一?」 (does the inline-edit date quick pick 「下周」 mean seven days from today, or next Monday?), the maintainer chose 「7 天后」 (option A of three) at 2026-11-21T04:13:57Z. The other two options were 「下周一」 (next Monday) and 「改叫「一周后」」 (same arithmetic, button renamed).

Recorded meaning, for slice S2 of this card:
- 「下周」 = today + 7 days, the same reading as 「明天」 = today + 1 day. Picked on a Wednesday it gives next Wednesday.
- The button keeps the label 「下周」 (in every locale, translated with the same meaning).
- The list filter preset `next_week` (Monday to Sunday of next week) is unrelated and unchanged.

Also settled by the seat, no ruling needed: the record picker's 「最近」 stays as it works today (the last picks per target object on this device). S3 prefixes its storage key with the user, so two accounts in one browser no longer share it.
